query: INSERT INTO task_claim_evaluations(evaluation_id,channel_id,bot_id,source_seq_from,source_seq_to,status,reserved_at,dispatched_at) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,'dispatched',NOW(),NOW()) ON CONFLICT(channel_id,bot_id,source_seq_from,source_seq_to) DO UPDATE SET status='dispatched', error=NULL, reserved_at=NOW(), dispatched_at=NOW(), completed_at=NULL WHERE task_claim_evaluations.status='failed' RETURNING evaluation_id
